name: protrusion_enclosure_cpm
description: Eukaryogenesis S3 (protrusions to enclosure), SPATIAL campaign composite B. A host and a symbiont on the real Rust CPM engine with actual boundaries; sweeping host-symbiont adhesion j_hs across j_sM - j_hM moves the system through the wrapping transition (stable enclosure -> transient -> partial cup -> free symbiont). Emits enc/enclosure_fraction (1 = fully enclosed) and enc/enclosed. Enclosure is emergent, not an imposed threshold.

j_hs.description: host-symbiont adhesion (low = strong adhesion = enclosure; transition at j_sM - j_hM = 12)
